title.en: Music Generation — MusicGen, Stable Audio, Suno, and the Licensing Earthquake

hook: 2026 music generation: Suno v5 and Udio v4 dominate commercial; MusicGen, Stable Audio Open, and ACE-Step lead open-source. The technical problem is mostly solved. The legal problem (Warner Music $500M settlement, UMG settlement) reshaped the field in 2025-2026.
